svg.title: One write path
svg.desc: Every change goes through one arbiter to a single root bridge, and the device is read back afterwards. A screen can never write to the kernel directly.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing touches the kernel behind your back.
